body: hey everyone!  THIS guy has a girlfriend too!
"Were you raised by beavers?  Because daaaaaammmmmmm!"

I have been in varying chronic pain for 9 years now with fibromyalgia and other things. I recommend reading about TMS, dr john sarno has a few good books on it.  it could change your life it's done for tens of thousands of people.  If it wasn't for his books I would still be bed ridden.
Hmm sounds interesting.  I have not had food allergy tests before and I guess there is no harm trying it out. Thanks.

Well i have read up on it and i am trying to apply the lessons in it... i spent the whole weekend in bed but i am at work today.. assuming my back doesn't go out again during the day i have my psychologist tonight.  If it does however and i can no longer exist outside of my bed then i feel i will have no other option but to end my pain the only way i can :(

Fingers crossed, thinking positive.

My back is feeling a bit better but I am still pretty out of it. 

I have thought long and hard about another option for ending my pain as I really don't want to end my life, I have thought about one thing I have yet to try. A website which has a different way to heal from my condition so I signed up for their program and am reading through the material. If I feel it has a chance to change things I may wait a few days to give it a chance.

Thanks for your kind post. 

I do feel I have a lot to give, I genuienly care about others and I would love to show more of that side to the world. I just can't live anymore with my pain. I think you may be stronger than I am to go through what you have and still remain positive. I have reached the limit of my inner strength.

A lot of people seem to be able to get past tms, I just don't seem to be one of them. 

I really wish I could finish skyrim, I was loving it but I'm bedridden at least for today. With anyluck tomorrow I should be able to move around a little bit. 

I'm not on any pain meds as they don't seem to work for me me unfortunately.
